name: man
summary: Shows the manual for a command.
description: Opens the official manual page in the less pager (q to quit, /pattern to search). Pages are grouped into sections: 1 for commands, 5 for file formats, 8 for administration. A reference such as passwd(5) means section 5. On Ubuntu, pages in other languages come in packages such as manpages-fr.

options.description: Searches for a keyword in the descriptions of every page (like apropos).
Shows the short description of the page (like whatis).
Shows every page with this name, in every section, one after the other.
Language of the pages, for example fr.

arguments.name: SECTION
arguments.description: Section number, if the same name exists in several sections.

arguments.name: PAGE
arguments.description: Command, file or function to look up.

examples.explanation: The format of the /etc/passwd file (section 5), not the passwd command.
Every page whose description mentions compression.
examples.output:
gzip (1)             - compress or expand files
zip (1)              - package and compress (archive) files
